expert.rationale: Level 3 (rubric anchor: Purpose and audience are clear on the entry surface and the main flow reflects the intended feelings, with minor inconsistencies.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Questions says what it is for in plain words with one obvious action (ASK). Waiting and Solved states, owner-code references and a SOLVED stamp show 'practical guidance' and accountability, with no likes or counters. Minor: the privacy text still names likes.

Level 3 (rubric anchor: A deliberate, consistent identity is visible across the main screens, with minor generic areas.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. The Yard (area band, owner-code references, stencil numerals, SOLVED stamp) is consistent across questions, solutions, topics and library, and recorded in DESIGN.md. Minor: DESIGN.md forbids side-stripe borders yet infodot.css has six.

Level 3 (rubric anchor: Main tasks are direct and clear, with minor friction on secondary screens.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Each screen has one clear next step (ask, filter, post your answer); topic filter and counts reduce hunting. Minor friction: Library appears in both the top tabs and the Knowledge sub-nav.

Level 3 (rubric anchor: Spacing, type, states and motion are consistent across screens and breakpoints, with minor roughness.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Measured: no horizontal overflow at 375, 768 or 1280px on the 13 Knowledge pages. Type and states are consistent. Reduced-motion coverage is partial (9 CSS declarations and Tailwind transition utilities have no override).

Level 3 (rubric anchor: Claims are supportable, data handling is stated plainly, and states are honest, with minor omissions.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. States say what is true: Solved only after acceptance, visibility spelled out (Everyone, Your company), references on everything, no invented counts. Minor omissions: the policy does not mention the third-party font and icon services loaded on every page, and still lists likes.

Level 2 (rubric anchor: The main flow is accessible; secondary screens or states have barriers.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. No assistive-technology test. Most controls are named (94%) and :focus-visible is on by default. the solution search results page removes outlines with no replacement (25), and a dark-theme checkbox ring on Points is 1.3:1. One img without alt sits in a component nothing mounts.
